label: Fourth Way existence and power across maximum readings
summary:
12dc2662-e160-4031-bc7b-0772c2ed2476 (Bridge): 6c6549ae consumes a transparent wrapper of MaximumInGenusCausesAllInGenusReading, specializing it to esse. It needs causal coverage of distinct actual bearers from each relevant weak maximum. The corresponding legacy formula shares the same body, so transporting its name would add no support. The pinned Fourth Way reading 73eece80 is about what is most such, and the reviewed greatest-degree interpretation supplies no coverage of incomparable weak maxima. Test the esse-only causal input for the same stage-two candidate, keeping direct source-of-esse evidence distinct from scalar maximality.

3b078622-0815-5f3c-9bc0-703de1c53a68 (Source lead): f74369e3 gets a common upper bearer from attainment. The pinned Fourth Way claim 0adb3da8 states attainment for being under its greatest-degree interpretation. The new support relation retains that narrower scope. Upper bounds, pairwise comparability and directedness individually leave attainment open outside that scope; see the scale cases in PR-2039. Look for a nonempty finite roster of actual selected-perfection bearers with total degree comparisons, or independent attainment evidence on the same scale.

3eb63770-6f36-5145-8d68-147cd3b62179 (Variant): 5106f118 and 75fc6c70 give the MAXIME_3 alternative. This is causal coverage conditional on strict greatness, and the weak-maximal causal formula would need an independently secured scope or implication. The direct MAXIME_1 sibling avoids strict greatness. Retain the strict-sense branch.

55a94a55-234d-50e1-8fda-1429ed5d2d3d (Variant): 312639cc uses an existential for the primitive interpretation of the existence use. A witness with one selected comparison type only transfers after the argument's sense agreement premise. The direct MAXIME_1 branch can use an attained weak maximum directly. Retain the scope of the mixed-use comparison.

a59a925d-b58f-5188-9573-94d251233d61 (Bridge): f5b624bf compares degrees only of actual bearers of the selected perfection. A linear order on the represented values would give the disjunction, but the current carrier has only a preorder. Making being itself a total strict order also excludes ties and changes the claim. Check whether evidence for a single ordered measure covers the selected bearers; a multidimensional capability ordering can yield incomparability when improvements trade off.

bdd770f7-f218-5d5d-887b-0b4efdb6318d (Variant): 312639cc uses the separate primitive for the causal use and consumes a same-sense agreement to connect it to the existence use. Causal coverage here is restricted to distinct actual esse bearers. The direct MAXIME_1 sibling bypasses the unresolved use-indexed predicate. Retain the sense comparison.
blocker: Existence, within-profile ordering, and productive causal coverage call for different evidence. The comparative definitions leave productive esse-cause edges independent.
